subject: Region hell
author: Xandu
body:
Seems like 1 vs 100 is only available in France, Germany, UK, Ireland, Canada, and USA because of license restrictions from Endemol that owns the rights to the game show. To play your gamertag needs to be created in one of the countries above and it must be associated with a credit card issued in the same country. Also your IP address must have orgin in the same country as your gamertag was created.

Personally I think any player should be able to join any game from any region. I understand that sending off prizes might be a problem but as long as there is a disclaimer about only being able to win "non digital" prizes in your own region that would not be a problem.
